properties.value: Lockfile dependency inventory entry for web3-react (Ethereum wallet-connector framework, yarn workspaces monorepo). hash.js@1.1.7 is locked at yarn.lock:5746 (hash.js@1.1.7, ^1.0.0, ^1.0.3, ^1.1.7) and ships SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 implementations. It is pulled in primarily as a dependency of elliptic@6.5.4 (yarn.lock:4518). No direct call site in the app's own packages/ sources; reachable transitively whenever elliptic runs (ECDSA signing on Ethereum keys). Changeable here by bump

properties.value: Dependency inventory entry: @noble/curves@1.0.0 locked at yarn.lock:1811, required by viem@1.2.5 (yarn.lock:9740) and @scure/bip32@1.3.0 (yarn.lock:2239). viem is the TypeScript Ethereum library used by the walletconnect connector example/stack; secp256k1 is the Bitcoin/Ethereum transaction-signing curve (keccak + ECDSA secp256k1). No direct secp256k1 call in web3-react's own packages/ sources — the curve runs inside viem/bip32 whenever a wallet derives keys or signs. Changeable here by dependen

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory entry: elliptic@6.5.4 locked at yarn.lock:4511 (elliptic@6.5.4, ^6.5.2, ^6.5.4), dependencies bn.js/brorand/hash.js/hmac-drbg. elliptic implements ECDSA (plus EdDSA/ECDH) on secp256k1, P-256 etc.; in the Ethereum toolchain it is the classic signing library. No direct elliptic import found in web3-react's own packages/ sources — it ships in the dependency tree of the wallet-connector build. Changeable here by dependency bump.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory entry: @noble/curves@1.0.0 locked at yarn.lock:1811 (required by viem@1.2.5 and @scure/bip32@1.3.0). The package ships P-256 (secp256r1) ECDSA/ECDH/Schnorr implementations. In this Ethereum-oriented build P-256 is likely dormant (secp256k1 is the working curve) but the code ships in the bundle and is importable. Changeable here by dependency bump.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory entry: elliptic@6.5.4 locked at yarn.lock:4511 includes the elliptic/ec module with ECDH (elliptic.diffieHellman) on secp256k1/P-256. Standalone ECDH is Shor-vulnerable key agreement — relevant harvest-now-decrypt-later if ever used for session keys. In this build no direct application call site invokes it; the capability ships in the bundle. Changeable here by dependency bump.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory entry: scrypt-js@3.0.1 locked at yarn.lock:8818 (scrypt-js@3.0.1, ^3.0.0). scrypt is the memory-hard password KDF used to encrypt Ethereum keystore files and (with different params) BIP39 mnemonics. Not Shor-vulnerable (Grover only halves its strength); parameters, not the algorithm, decide its posture. Ships in the build's dependency tree; no direct call site in web3-react's own packages/ sources. Changeable here by dependency bump.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory entry: @noble/hashes@1.3.0 locked at yarn.lock:1818, required by viem@1.2.5 (yarn.lock:9741), @scure/bip32@1.3.0 and @scure/bip39@1.2.0. Ships SHA-3/Keccak — keccak256 is the Ethereum hashing primitive (tx hashes, addresses, ABI), so this is exercised whenever viem derives an address or hashes a payload. Changeable here by dependency bump.
